page_title: BAR 1-2 RMA | Barcelona v Real Madrid 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Raphinha (Barcelona) will take the corner.
90+6' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
90+6' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) will replace Vinicius Junior.
90+5' An attempted cross from Raphinha (Barcelona) is cleared.

90+2' 1 - 2 What a brilliant goal by Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid)! He collected a well-executed pass that had put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper. He took the goal-scoring opportunity with a shot to the middle of the goal past the keeper.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Joselu (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
86' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

85' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Madrid are going to take it.
84' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) trips an opposition player and Jesus Gil Manzano signals a foul.
82' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Barcelona.
80' Gavi (Barcelona) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.

79' Raphinha sprays a wonderful pass out to Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Kepa Arrizabalaga problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just over the crossbar.
79' PENALTY APPEAL after Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
78' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Raphinha (Barcelona) coming on for Joao Felix.
77' Xavi has decided to make a change. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) replaces Joao Cancelo.
76' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
74' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jesus Gil Manzano signals. Real Madrid earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
73' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

73' Joselu (Real Madrid) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
72' Substitution. Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) in, Fermin Lopez out.
71' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' 1 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
68' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).

67' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
67' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
65' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes a short corner kick.

65' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
64' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Joselu (Real Madrid) for Rodrygo.
63' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Toni Kroos and he is replaced by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
61' That's the end of the game for Ferran Torres, who is replaced by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
61' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Gil Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
60' A pass from Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is intercepted by Kepa Arrizabalaga and the move breaks down.
59' Flag up against Joao Cancelo (Barcelona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

57' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen was alert and the score remained the same.
55' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Vinicius Junior, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen displays great awareness to stop him.
54' The attendance for today's match is 50112.
54' The corner kick from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
53' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.
52' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
52' Substitution. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) has come on for Ferland Mendy.

52' Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.
51' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the left post and away off it.
51' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
50' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Barcelona.
50' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who smothers the ball.
47' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes a first-time shot from inside the box, but his poor effort flies way wide of the right post.
47' Gavi (Barcelona) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ferran Torres (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Jesus Gil Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+1' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45+1' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Barcelona.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' The resulting corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

44' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
43' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
42' Joao Felix (Barcelona) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
41' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
40' A clumsy foul by Joao Felix (Barcelona) and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle.
38' Close! Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
37' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
36' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
35' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is penalised for holding. Jesus Gil Manzano signals a set piece.
34' The ball possession at the moment is 57:43.
32' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
31' Barcelona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
28' Joao Felix (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
27' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 4:8.
25' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
24' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle after Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.

22' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.

21' Ferran Torres almost found himself in a promising position after Joao Felix (Barcelona) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
17' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
16' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
13' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
12' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
9' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle as Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
8' A pass from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is intercepted by Marc-Andre ter Stegen and the move breaks down.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
5' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
4' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) commits a foul and Jesus Gil Manzano immediately signals a free kick.
3' A pass by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Barcelona will have the kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano will referee today's match.
